parts.title: Meet Pip
parts.text: Ruth, Kai, and Nadia got a new puppy named Pip. He was soft and **cuddly**, with **floppy** ears. Pip began to **sniff** every corner of the house.

parts.title: Pip Plays
parts.text: Pip was **frisky** and ready to **romp**. Kai threw a ball, and Pip ran to **fetch** it. Nadia laughed. “What a **playful** pup!” she said.

parts.title: A Bit of Trouble
parts.text: Then Pip got into **mischief**. He grabbed a sock and hid under a chair. “You little **rascal**!” said Ruth. She tried to **scold** him in a cross voice, but he looked too sweet. Pip began to **whine** with a small, sad sound. He was tired and ready to **snooze**.

parts.title: Sweet Dreams
parts.text: Soon Pip was fast asleep. Nadia put him in a warm bed. The three friends smiled. They loved their new pup. Pip dreamed of balls and bones. It was the best day ever.
